# stalelink

> stalelink is a local Rust CLI for scanning documents for dead, redirected, stale, authenticated, malformed, and broken local links. It produces table, JSON, and SARIF reports, caches HTTP verdicts locally, and previews or applies safe link fixes.

Repository: https://github.com/jishnuteegala/stalelink
License: MIT

## Project

- [README](README.md)
- [Report JSON schema](schema/stalelink-report.v1.json)
- [License](LICENSE)

## Documentation

- [Domain context](CONTEXT.md)
- [Agent documentation](docs/agents/)

No telemetry is collected. Requested link checks make network requests and their verdicts are cached locally unless `--no-cache` is used.
